svg.title: The pattern persists. Until it does not.
svg.desc: A schematic expectation curve rises with repeated feeding and stays high before the surprise. At the regime boundary the observed outcome differs from the prediction; no probability values or measured data are shown.
svg.text: The pattern persists. Until it does not.
Hume: past observations do not logically guarantee the next outcome.
The surprise belongs to the world. The confidence belonged to the model.
Conceptual timeline, not measured probabilities. No guarantee of automatic uncertainty detection.
